canonical_project: Artnet Data Centers, Gdansk and Gdynia
notes: Operator page says Artnet has two independent Tier III-class data centers in the Tri-City: Gdansk at Marynarki Polskiej 100 and Gdynia at Chwaszczynska 133A. Baxtel lists Pomeranian Voivodeship market presence and identifies Artnet Gdynia as the largest local facility by listed floor area.
